articleTitle: Vercel Homepage Teardown: Jul 2021 to Jun 2026
h1: How Vercel rewrote its homepage over 5 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jul 2021 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Develop.Preview.Ship." — direct product statement.

Visible section headings include: "Vercel combines the best developer experience with an obsessive focus on end-user performance. Our platform enables frontend teams to do their best work.", "Clone Template".
Section headings later removed include: "Vercel combines the best developer experience with an obsessive focus on end-user performance. Our platform enables frontend teams to do their best work.".

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2023 — mid-transition
analysis-blocks.heading: Mid-period: signs of a structural shift
annotations: Visual similarity to the previous snapshot: unknown — a moderate visual change.
New section headings appearing: "Vercel is the platform for frontend developers, providing the speed and reliability innovators need to create at the moment of inspiration.", "Product".
Changes across this period appear incremental rather than a single redesign event.

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Build and deploy on the AI Cloud." — updated value proposition.
CTAs no longer present include: "Contact", "Contact Us", "Login".

messaging.after: Build and deploy on the AI Cloud.
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Deploy web projects with the best frontend developer experience and highest end-user performance.
messaging.after: Vercel gives developers the frameworks, workflows, and infrastructure to build a faster, more personalized web.
messaging.note: Meta description updated. The change in framing may reflect a positioning adjustment or an SEO update.

messaging.before: Develop. Preview. Ship. For the best frontend teams – Vercel
messaging.after: Vercel: Build and deploy the best web experiences with the AI Cloud
